preview.text: Bhutan and Myanmar meet in a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where Bhutan has won all of their 6 previous recorded T20 meetings. Bhutan won the toss and chose to bat first, aiming for a score above the usual first-innings total of 118 seen across the 85 recorded T20 matches at this ground.

summary.text: Bhutan won by 27 runs. BTN made 119-8, Thinley Jamtsho (c) top-scoring with 40 off 27 balls; Paing Danu took 3 for 23. MMR made 92-9, Paing Danu top-scoring with 16 off 19 balls; Gakul Ghalley took 3 for 28. Sides batting first at Bayuemas Oval usually make about 118.
